items.title: Josef Balcerak Interview, 1968-05-17
items.q: For instance, in Warsaw, I have Leopold Tiermann, our writer, fewer lectures, if I know, in Warsaw clubs.

ctx.x: Yes. Well, what happened after the war was over?

When war is over, I have been in the Navy, Polish Navy, as an editor of Navy magazine. And I have no special connections with music, few years until 1948. And in this time I have finished my military service and began to work in Radio Gdańsk. You know that in Gdańsk was the first shot of Second World War. It was very interesting work for me, because I have been employed in the Department of Reports from sailors' life and so on.
